verdict.rationale: Weave's own marketing page says custom signals classify agent interactions and that alerts route through Slack and trigger webhook automations. A release note confirms you can define custom signals to tag agent turns. That is a first-party event-to-action capability, but it is described only at a high level, with no in-depth docs on configuring rules, conditions, or actions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining trigger rules and conditions, the supported event types and action types beyond Slack and webhooks, setup instructions for alert/automation rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
